units.source_text: 太吉郎端坐在桌前，脑中浮现出宗达和光琳画的蕨菜，以及春天的花草画。

en.t: Takichiro sat upright at the table, and in his mind appeared the bracken painted by Sotatsu and Korin, along with pictures of spring flowers and grasses.

units.source_text: 心里思念着刚刚离去的女儿。

en.t: In his heart, he was thinking fondly of the daughter who had just left.
